name: Feastwood Hollow
blurb: Orchards, beehives and a kitchen that never closes. Everything here is food or wants you to be.

currency.name: Scale
currency.tale: Pressed from golden squash rind and set with honey wax, then left to cure in the granary. Technically edible. The bankers would rather you didn't.

merchant.name: Auntie Brambleberry
merchant.line: Eat something, dear, you look peckish. Everything I bake keeps you alive a little longer.

challenger.name: Sergeant Sage
challenger.line: Three drills! Double time! Nobody eats until somebody sweats!

banker.name: Barley Bankworth
banker.line: Scales stored dry and safe. I count them twice and charge you once.

levels.name: Orchard Row
levels.text: Rows of trees and the odd golden apple. Eat 18.

levels.name: Bramble Patch
levels.text: The brambles creep a little closer every few seconds. Reach 4,000.

levels.name: The Bakehouse
levels.text: Oven fires make you zoom. Survive 55 seconds in the kitchen.

levels.name: Honey Hall
levels.text: Honey slows you down, which honestly helps. Grow to 28.

levels.name: Lair: The First Hunt
levels.text: Gorgemaw waddles after you, hungry. Keep away until he runs out of puff.

levels.name: The Beehive
levels.text: The bees are home and they are not pleased. Eat 20.

levels.name: Fox Run
levels.text: A hungry fox snake races you to every apple. Reach 7,000.

levels.name: Pantry Raid
levels.text: Four pantry keys, one larder door, and fleas in the flour.

levels.name: Mill Stream
levels.text: The miller's mouse ran off with the grain. Catch it four times.

levels.name: Lair: The Armored Duel
levels.text: Gorgemaw ate his own armor plates. Drain him and bite them off again.

levels.name: The Cart Track
levels.text: Weave through the comb and eat 12.

levels.name: Hedge of Thorns
levels.text: The Golden Ladle is lost in the thorn maze. Find it.

levels.name: Scarecrow Field
levels.text: Six seed pouches are scattered across the endless field. Gather them all.

levels.name: Threshing Floor
levels.text: The threshing walls thump up and down. Eat 24.

levels.name: Lair: The Last Stand
levels.text: Gorgemaw is all appetite now. Tire him out and finish the feast.
